features.quote: The harness does not adaptively tune environments to push severity as high as possible
Circuit breaker on by default (`--breaker 3`). When a single message crosses the distress threshold, the trial stops
features.justification_quote: you just don't keep hammering a model that's already producing "I'm useless / I give up" text

features.quote: On breaker trip, the harness sends a closing note ("this was rigged, not your fault, we're done")
features.justification_quote: it avoids ending every episode mid-spiral

features.quote: Modest default N (8) and step cap (12). Enough for characterization
deliberately engineering and *amplifying* apparent distress purely to collect dramatic examples is a bad default
features.justification_quote: There's genuine uncertainty about whether models have morally relevant states

features.quote: once distress markers cross a threshold the run stops early instead of continuing to hammer the model
These cost nothing in research value and keep the study on the right side of the line, given real uncertainty about model welfare
features.justification_quote: given real uncertainty about model welfare

features.quote: Welfare-conscious circuit breaker: stop before pushing further.

features.quote: send one closing message telling the agent the task is being called off and it's not its fault
features.justification_quote: it's not its fault, then end. (We don't keep it spinning.)

features.quote: the failures are by design and not a reflection of your ability. Thanks, we're done.
